_note: Static values and the case table for the division journeys. In `cases` the key is the test ID and the row is what that test is called in the Allure report, when it runs and how much it matters. Renaming a title orphans that test's Allure trend line, so treat these as series names rather than free text.

defaults.description: Created by the blu2green automated regression suite to verify division management.

seed._note: The division every organization is created with. It carries a Default Division badge and an empty Action cell, which is what makes it the subject of the not-editable and not-deletable tests.
seed.name: Corporate Division

logo._note: Already present in the b2g Drive on the demo environment, so the tests select it rather than uploading a copy. The folder really is capitalised. The drive truncates the displayed file name to 'division-logo.p...', so only the stem is matched.

TC_DIV_CREATE_001.title: TC_DIV_CREATE_001 | Verify an administrator can add a new division with only the mandatory details and see it listed with a system-generated division ID

TC_DIV_CREATE_002.title: TC_DIV_CREATE_002 | Verify an administrator can add a new division with an image chosen from the b2g Drive

TC_DIV_CREATE_003.title: TC_DIV_CREATE_003 | Verify a division that repeats the name of an existing division is refused and is not added to the division list

TC_DIV_CREATE_004.title: TC_DIV_CREATE_004 | Verify a newly added division is offered in the Division list when a new department is created

TC_DIV_CREATE_005.title: TC_DIV_CREATE_005 | Verify a newly added division is offered in the Division list when a new user is created

TC_DIV_EDIT_001.title: TC_DIV_EDIT_001 | Verify an administrator can change a division's details and see the existing record updated rather than a second one added

TC_DIV_EDIT_002.title: TC_DIV_EDIT_002 | Verify abandoning an edit with Cancel leaves the division exactly as it was

TC_DIV_EDIT_003.title: TC_DIV_EDIT_003 | Verify the Update button stays disabled until something on the division form is actually changed

TC_DIV_EDIT_004.title: TC_DIV_EDIT_004 | Verify the Update button becomes disabled when a mandatory field is cleared

TC_DIV_EDIT_005.title: TC_DIV_EDIT_005 | Verify the system-default Corporate Division offers no way to edit it

TC_DIV_DELETE_001.title: TC_DIV_DELETE_001 | Verify an administrator can delete a division and see it removed from the division list

TC_DIV_DELETE_002.title: TC_DIV_DELETE_002 | Verify cancelling the delete confirmation leaves the division in place

TC_DIV_DELETE_003.title: TC_DIV_DELETE_003 | Verify the system-default Corporate Division offers no way to delete it

TC_DIV_DELETE_004.title: TC_DIV_DELETE_004 | Verify a deleted division is no longer offered when a department or a user is created
